name: Open-MP | Loxy v2
author: danielolxlol@gmail.com
description: Egg Open-MP atualizada para runtime Debian 12/Bookworm com suporte i386. Usa a imagem ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/games:samp, que inclui libatomic1 e libatomic1:i386, além das bibliotecas legadas necessárias para OpenMP/SA-MP. Instala automaticamente a versão latest ou uma tag específica do open.mp sem sobrescrever arquivos existentes do cliente.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
REPO="openmultiplayer/open.mp"
VERSION="${VERSION:-latest}"

echo "=================================================="
echo "  Open-MP Installer - Loxy v2"
echo "=================================================="
echo "[1/6] Preparando dependencias do instalador..."

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    jq \
    tar \
    unzip \
    file
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}"

TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"' EXIT

echo "[2/6] Consultando release do open.mp..."

if [[ -z "${VERSION}" || "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]]; then
    RELEASE_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
else
    RELEASE_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi

if ! RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
    -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    -H "User-Agent: Pterodactyl-OpenMP-Installer" \
    "${RELEASE_API}")"; then
    echo "[AVISO] Nao foi possivel localizar a versao '${VERSION}'."
    echo "[AVISO] Usando a release mais recente."
    RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
        -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
        -H "User-Agent: Pterodactyl-OpenMP-Installer" \
        "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest")"
fi

RELEASE_TAG="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.tag_name // "desconhecida"')"

# Prefere o build Linux x86 com OpenSSL dinamico, igual à Egg oficial atual.
# Esse build funciona melhor com o runtime moderno do Ptero-Eggs.
DOWNLOAD_LINK="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '
    .assets[]
    | select(.name | test("^open\.mp-linux-x86-dynssl\.tar\.gz$"; "i"))
    | .browser_download_url
' | head -n1)"

# Fallback para o pacote Linux x86 padrão.
if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" || "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" == "null" ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '
        .assets[]
        | select(.name | test("^open\.mp-linux-x86\.tar\.gz$"; "i"))
        | .browser_download_url
    ' | head -n1)"
fi

# Último fallback caso o projeto altere levemente o nome do asset.
if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" || "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" == "null" ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '
        .assets[]
        | select(.name | test("linux.*x86.*\.tar\.gz$"; "i"))
        | .browser_download_url
    ' | head -n1)"
fi

if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" || "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" == "null" ]]; then
    echo "[ERRO] Nao encontrei o pacote Linux x86 do open.mp na release ${RELEASE_TAG}."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[3/6] Baixando open.mp ${RELEASE_TAG}..."
curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
    -o "${TMP_DIR}/openmp.tar.gz" \
    "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"

echo "[4/6] Extraindo arquivos..."
mkdir -p "${TMP_DIR}/extract"
tar -xzf "${TMP_DIR}/openmp.tar.gz" -C "${TMP_DIR}/extract"

if [[ -d "${TMP_DIR}/extract/Server" ]]; then
    cp -a "${TMP_DIR}/extract/Server/." "${SERVER_DIR}/"
else
    OMP_BINARY="$(find "${TMP_DIR}/extract" -type f -name omp-server -print -quit || true)"
    if [[ -z "${OMP_BINARY}" ]]; then
        echo "[ERRO] O pacote baixado nao contem o binario omp-server."
        exit 1
    fi
    OMP_ROOT="$(dirname "${OMP_BINARY}")"
    cp -a "${OMP_ROOT}/." "${SERVER_DIR}/"
fi

echo "[5/6] Instalando gamemode base sem sobrescrever arquivos existentes..."
BASE_URL="https://github.com/drysius/Eggs/raw/main/Connect/Open-MP/SampGmBase.zip"

if curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
    -o "${TMP_DIR}/SampGmBase.zip" \
    "${BASE_URL}"; then
    unzip -nq "${TMP_DIR}/SampGmBase.zip" -d "${SERVER_DIR}" || true
else
    echo "[AVISO] Gamemode base nao foi baixada. O open.mp foi instalado normalmente."
fi

echo "[6/6] Ajustando configuracao e permissoes..."

if [[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg" ]]; then
    # Garante RCON valido em instalacoes novas.
    if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*rcon_password[[:space:]]+' "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"; then
        echo "rcon_password ${RCON_PASSWORD:-MeMudePorFavor}" >> "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"
    fi

    # Mantem saida do log no console do painel.
    if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*output[[:space:]]+' "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"; then
        echo "output 1" >> "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"
    fi

    if ! grep -Fq "Note To change some values go to startup" "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"; then
        echo "Note To change some values go to startup, and change it!" >> "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"
    fi

    if ! grep -Fq "Notas Para alterar alguns valores va para startup" "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"; then
        echo "Notas Para alterar alguns valores va para startup, e altere la!" >> "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"
    fi
fi

chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/omp-server"

# Plugins Linux normalmente precisam ser executaveis/leitura global.
find "${SERVER_DIR}/plugins" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.so" -exec chmod 755 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
find "${SERVER_DIR}/components" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.so" -exec chmod 755 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

chown -R root:root "${SERVER_DIR}"
export HOME="${SERVER_DIR}"

echo "=================================================="
echo " Instalacao concluida: open.mp ${RELEASE_TAG}"
echo " Runtime: ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/games:samp"
echo "=================================================="
